title: Why Shop Receipts Fade Over Time 🧾

shots.vo: Why does your receipt turn blank after a few months?

shots.vo: Here's the strange part: that printer has no ink at all.

shots.vo: The paper itself is coated with a chemical that turns black with heat.
shots.prompt: a strip of white thermal paper with one half turning black under a hot metal print head, glowing heat, macro close-up, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing

shots.vo: The printer just heats tiny dots, and the dots turn dark.
shots.prompt: a thermal print head with rows of tiny glowing orange dots pressing on white paper, dark dots appearing behind it, macro close-up, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing

shots.vo: But sunlight, a hot wallet or rubbing triggers the same reaction slowly.
shots.prompt: a receipt turning dark and unreadable on a car dashboard in strong sunlight, wallet beside it, bright window light, close-up, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing

shots.vo: That's why receipts fade: the ink was only ever heat-sensitive paper.
